paper: Rethinking the Up-Sampling Operations in CNN-based Generative Network for Generalizable Deepfake Detection (NPR — Neighboring Pixel Relationships). Tan, Liu, Zhao, Wei, Gu, Liu, Wei — CVPR 2024.
training_set_in_paper: ProGAN 4-class (car, cat, chair, horse) from the ForenSynths/CNNDetection train/val set; real=LSUN, fake=ProGAN, binary real(0)/fake(1). Paper Sec 4.1 / repo README L43-49,135-137. The SAME ProGAN-4class model is used for ALL of Tables 1-5. (The repo README also has a SECONDARY GenImage section that retrains on sdv4 with seed 70 — README L178-238 — and an AIGCDetectBenchmark section using a separate checkpoint model_epoch_last_3090.pth — README L148-176; neither is the CVPR paper's main 4-class result.)

benchmarks.name: Table 1 — ForenSynths / Cross-GAN-Sources (8 GANs) — HEADLINE

paper_number.note: Paper Table 1 'NPR(our)' Mean = 92.5 acc / 96.1 AP. Confirmed in arXiv HTML and in the repo README's commented-out main table (README L255).

benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: test.py L25-29 'ForenSynths': no_resize=False, no_crop=True. data/datasets.py L35-39 -> since no_resize=False the rz_func = transforms.Resize((loadSize, loadSize)); options/base_options.py L30 loadSize default = 256, so SQUARE Resize to (256,256). no_crop=True -> crop_func = identity (datasets.py L26-27). Then ToTensor + Normalize(ImageNet mean/std) (datasets.py L48-49). Model = networks/resnet.py resnet50(num_classes=1), checkpoint NPR.pth loaded strict=True (test.py L53-55). The NPR residual transform (x - up(down(x,.5),2))*2/3 is applied INSIDE the network's first stage. Metric = sklearn average_precision_score + accuracy_score@0.5 (validate.py L20-23). seed_torch(100) (test.py L24). Eval set = ONLY the 8 GAN dirs listed in the README directory tree (README L78-95); crn/imle/san/seeingdark/whichfaceisreal are NOT part of NPR's ForenSynths.

our_number.note: Our npr_official_forensynths.json logs the full 13-gen mean 79.45 mAP; the 8-GAN subset {progan,cyclegan,biggan,gaugan,stargan,stylegan,stylegan2,deepfake} computes to 92.81 mAP / 91.83 acc.

benchmarks.gap_cause: TWO compounding causes. (A) WRONG CHECKPOINT — the primary cause. SynthScope's npr.pth is symlinked to model_epoch_last_3090.pth (interface/scripts/collect_checkpoints.py:26), NOT to the repo's NPR.pth that produced the paper's Table 1. Verified the two files are genuinely different ProGAN-4class training runs: same 146-key architecture after stripping the 'module.' prefix, but conv1.weight differs by up to 0.26 (not identical); NPR.pth is a full train-state dict {model,optimizer,total_steps} (the README 'Testing the detector' default, L143), while model_epoch_last_3090.pth is a bare state_dict the README ties to the AIGCDetectBenchmark table (L148). The deficit is concentrated on the three lowest-quality generators — biggan -8.9 (85.59 vs 94.5), deepfake -10.1 (76.06 vs 86.2), gaugan -5.8 (82.97 vs 88.8) — while progan/stylegan/stylegan2/stargan match to within 0.05, exactly the signature of a slightly different checkpoint rather than a preprocessing bug. (B) Preprocessing is NOT the cause here: SynthScope's npr spec transform = tf_square_resize(256, None, IMAGENET_MEAN, IMAGENET_STD) = Resize((256,256)) + no crop (registry.py:248), which MATCHES the official no_resize=False/no_crop=True/loadSize=256 recipe. Fix: re-link npr.pth -> NPR.pth and re-run to recover ~96.

summary: NPR reports 5 paper tables (1-5). We reproduce 4 (Tables 2,3,4,5 within ~0.4 mAP / a few acc points). Table 1 (ForenSynths-8) is BELOW: 92.81 mAP vs paper 96.1. Primary, concrete cause: SynthScope's npr.pth is the wrong checkpoint (model_epoch_last_3090.pth, the AIGCDetect-associated run) rather than the repo's NPR.pth that produced Table 1 — verified weight-different (same 146-key arch, conv1.weight maxdiff 0.26); the gap is isolated to biggan/deepfake/gaugan while progan/stylegan(2)/stargan match to <0.05. Preprocessing is NOT the cause — SynthScope's Resize((256,256))+no-crop matches the official no_resize=False/no_crop=True/loadSize=256 recipe (registry.py:248 vs datasets.py L35-39 + base_options L30). Fix = re-link npr.pth to NPR.pth. All NPR test data (Tables 1-5) is now present on disk (the earlier 'MISSING' status for Tables 3/5 was stale).
